metadata.description: Context and cost tooling for Claude Code: the context-optimizer plugin (CCO).

plugins.name: context-optimizer
plugins.description: Cuts what Claude Code sessions cost: Haiku 5.5 subagents do the reading and test runs so the expensive model's context stays small, and /cco-audit shows from your own transcripts where the money went and what was saved. Plus read dedup with file maps, cache-break and budget warnings, task state that survives /compact, and a one-screen /cco control center. Runs locally; the plugin's code makes no network calls.
